# WEB BOX SA

> WEB BOX SA is a free, independent browser game library. Browse a curated catalogue of browser-playable games with search and category filters. No registration, no payment.

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://webbox-sa.pages.dev/)
- [About](https://webbox-sa.pages.dev/pages/about.html)
- [Support & Feedback](https://webbox-sa.pages.dev/pages/support.html)
- [Privacy Policy](https://webbox-sa.pages.dev/pages/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Use](https://webbox-sa.pages.dev/pages/terms.html)

## Notes
- The site does not host games. It links to third-party browser-game destinations.
- Game availability depends on third-party sources and may change without notice.
- Some entries may be unavailable due to copyright complaints or source removal.
